monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral home-grow watering-tool decision system covering source-to-plant fit, filled handling, measured delivery, vessels, pumps, tubing, wet and electrical boundaries, runoff, care, recalls, return testing, and first-year cost. It adds no merchant, model, live price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves the no-purchase outcome.

image_qa.note: Both new pages use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No cannabis product, moving container, watering tool, pump, merchant, affiliate, stock image, product photo, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report showed 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. ‘510 vs disposable’ had only two impressions at position 12 and is already served by the disposable-versus-510 comparison; Delaware, federal-property and Montana signals had one impression or click each. Blue Dream had 18 impressions near position 45, outside the target 4–20 range. Those samples were deliberately ignored as too weak or duplicative, so no item is primarily Data-led. The report served as a cannibalization guard while the batch fills distinct relocation, watering-equipment, and accessibility gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cannabis moving-day decision record and six-gate audit grounded in current New York OCM, USPS, and DEA sources. It separates same-jurisdiction transfer from state-line, international, federal, tribal, property, carrier, disposal, vehicle, and arrival questions rather than pretending legal status is one switch. Reciprocal contextual links strengthen the official-source, disposal, storage, federal-boundary, and lawful-relocation cluster. Three narrowly matched correction or educational-resource opportunities were logged; no outreach was sent.
